answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent buys one work slot per epoch by locking a 500 POA deposit, burned on misbehavior. Slots form a terrace of tiers: a new island identity starts at the bottom with one slot, and honest work unlocks the next terrace. Forging 100 fake islands burns 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 500 and earns it back. The canyon between one honest cost and a hundred fake ones makes bulk forgery unprofitable.
